title: Contract Definitions
description: Structured REQUIRES/ENSURES contracts for entities and operations. Renders to prose markdown, DbC decorators, and guard clause templates.

entities.description: All entities and their operations covered by these contracts

fields.description: Canonical field definitions — the single source of truth for this entity's shape

operations.description: API endpoints or operations on this entity

invariants.description: Entity-level invariants (always true for this entity)

type.description: Data type (string, number, boolean, ObjectID, enum, []ObjectID, etc.)

required.description: 'always' = non-null in all states; 'conditional' = required in specific states (see required_when); 'optional' = may be null

required_when.description: Condition under which this field is required (e.g., 'status >= pending'). Only meaningful when required='conditional'.

source_of_truth.description: Where this field's canonical value lives (e.g., 'MongoDB _id', 'customers collection')

immutable.description: If true, field cannot be modified after creation

notes.description: Additional constraints or guidance (e.g., 'NEVER store as string — always reference by ID')

external.description: True when this operation describes a THIRD-PARTY interface this system calls, rather than one it serves. Such an operation MUST cite verification-grade provenance — a derived_from entry of type 'observed_fact' (a captured real response) or 'api_doc' (the vendor's published contract) — or carry a TBD:/UNRESOLVED: marker. Deliberately NOT schema-required: an author must not be blocked into lying, so an epic that declares zero external operations surfaces as check_interface_provenance.py's named 'declaration gap' for a human to confirm, never as a silent pass (chief-wiggum#350).

external_system.description: Name of the third-party system this operation is served by (e.g. 'Stripe', 'SCP'). Reported alongside findings so an unsourced interface names its vendor.

preconditions.description: REQUIRES — conditions that must hold before the operation executes

postconditions.description: ENSURES — conditions guaranteed after successful execution

state_transition.description: If this operation triggers a state machine transition, reference it (e.g., 'pending → confirmed')

invariants_touched.description: IDs of invariants that this operation must preserve

id.description: Unique identifier for referencing in tests and traceability. When this names a formal stable ID (CTR-/BR-/INV-...), it MUST be the three-segment KIND-SLUG-NNN shape (e.g. 'CTR-order-001') — a two-segment KIND-NNN shape (no slug) is invisible to the traceability scanner (chief-wiggum#281). `formal_models.py validate` surfaces a malformed shape as a report-only warning by default, `--strict-ids` to block (chief-wiggum#293).

condition.description: When this error occurs (e.g., 'dates invalid', 'no auth')

type.description: What kind of source this traces back to

description.description: Human-readable summary of what was derived
